appJobId.description: The app's tracked job id whose ALREADY-OPEN PR should be amended (must be PR_OPEN with a branch).

parentRef.description: The new <parent> reference to set inside the app pom (e.g. the newly-released parent-pom).

groupId.description: Parent groupId to match (optional; matched loosely when omitted).

pomPath.description: DO NOT set this normally. The app's own pom path is AUTO-DERIVED from the tracked app job (its changePlan), so a multi-module app under a sub-dir (e.g. customer-web-eapi/pom.xml) is amended in the correct file. Only override for a genuinely unusual layout.

jiraTicketId.description: Optional Jira ticket ID appended to the amendment commit message.
